newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cathay Pacific orders three more Airbus planes.
newsitem.headline: Cathay Pacific orders three more Airbus planes.

text.p: European plane manufacturer Airbus Industrie said Cathay Pacific Airways had signed a contract for three more ulta long-range A340-300 planes, increasing to nine the number it has placed firm orders for.

The newly-ordered four-engine aircraft will be delivered during the second and third quarters of 1998 and will be operated on non-stop services linking Hong Kong with destinations in Europe and North America.
Airbus has a total of 325 firm orders for the A330/A340 family of planes with 250 to 350 seats.

Airbus Industrie is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
